d: Flying cars are no longer science fiction! China’s XPeng is preparing to take its airborne vehicles to the skies, potentially as early as 2027. But Elon Musk’s Tesla is also entering the race with its next-generation Roadster. So, who is really leading the flying car revolution? We look at XPeng’s $300,000 flying machine, Tesla’s rocket-inspired stunts, China’s ambitions to dominate low-altitude aviation, and the massive challenges surrounding safety, cost, regulations and infrastructure. Are flying cars the future of transportation, or just another expensive billionaire fantasy? Watch…
